Ben / team —

Quick findings from an initial look (15m):
- Timeline correlation: a config push at 23:35 PT changed tenant eviction thresholds and moved Opal to a more aggressive global eviction policy for KV windows.
- Symptoms match HOL (head-of-line) blocking on hot keys: eviction churn appears to invalidate large prefix caches causing repeated cold loads and queueing at the hot-lane.
- Error spike (500s/429s) aligns with queue saturation events on the hot-lane coordinator.

Immediate mitigation steps I recommend (ordered by risk):
1) Revert Opal's tenant to the previous KV eviction profile (low-risk, targeted). Can be done in ~10–15m and should reduce thrash.
2) Throttle batch size for Opal routes to reduce queueing pressure (temporary, low-impact to cost).
3) Enable tenant-level cache pinning for top-10 hot prefixes for Opal (requires a short config push, ~30m ETA).

I'll start the revert now and post updates. I'm attaching a quick QPS chart from our telemetry.

Laura
Sr. Engineer, Serving Runtime
